summary: 55-year-old Ohio man fell into the water near Alberta Falls and could no longer proceed; found hypothermic with numerous injuries; brought down the trail by a park litter team and taken by ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center
location: Near Alberta Falls, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers; Estes Park Medical Center paramedics
notes: One of three incidents Mon Sep 12, 2011 per the Tue Sep 20 report; weekday-verified.
